cardEffects:
While you have a level 5 [WarGrowlmon], [Taomon] or [Rapidmon], you can ignore this card's color requirements.
[Main] Play 1 [WarGrowlmon] Token (Digimon/Red/6000 DP), 1 [Taomon] Token (Digimon/Yellow/6000 DP), and 1 [Rapidmon] Token (Digimon/Green/6000 DP). This effect can't play tokens with the same names as your Digimon. Then, 1 of your level 5 Digimon gains ＜Alliance＞ twice for the turn and attacks.
name: Trinity Burst!

references.text: Official JP Q&A for BT19-091 (2024/09/20, translated by DeepL)

rulings.answer: The card is either "my card with the name "WarGrowlmon" lv.5" or "my card with the name "TaoMon" lv.5" or "my card with the name "RapidMon" lv.5".
rulings.question: Can the first effect of this card ignore color requirements while any Digimon is present?

rulings.answer: No, "WarGrowlmon" tokens cannot play. The "ACE" described in the name is not included in the name.
rulings.question: If I activate the [Main] effect of this card when I have my "WarGrowlmon ACE", can I play each of the tokens "WarGrowlmon", "TaoMon" and "RapidMon"?

rulings.answer: No, it cannot. Tokens played by the [Main] effect of this card do not have Lv. You cannot choose these tokens because only your Digimon of Lv. 5 can be chosen by the "After" and subsequent effects of this effect.
rulings.question: Can I select a token played by this card's [Main] effect and after "after" this effect, give that Digimon two "linkages" and attack with that Digimon?

rulings.answer: No, you cannot. ≪You must attack as much as possible with the Digimon that gave you two "linkages".
rulings.question: Can the [Main] effect of this card not attack with that Digimon after giving it 2 [Linkage]?

rulings.answer: The card is a card with the name "WarGrowlmon" Lv.5, or "TaoMon" Lv.5, or "RapidMon" Lv.5.
rulings.question: Which cards can play under the [Security] effect of this card?

securityEffect: [Security] You may play 1 level 5 [WarGrowlmon], [Taomon] or [Rapidmon] from your hand without paying the cost.
